newsitem.title: USA: RF Power says weak demand to affect results.
newsitem.headline: RF Power says weak demand to affect results.

text.p: RF Power Products Inc said it expects weak demand conditions to affect the company's operating results for the balance of the fiscal year.

In a third quarter ending August 31, 1996 financial results statement, the company said earnings were affected by the "sharp slowdown in semiconductor demand evident throughout the industry," but that it was taking steps to "reduce manufacturing costs sharply."
RF Power added that income for the quarter was affected by higher research and development expenses to support the company's new product development program.
RF Power reported a net income for the third quarter 1996 of $247,000, or $0.02 per share, compared to net income $731,000, or $0.06 per share, for the same period last year.
